title: Reviews, trials and workers launch in one cycle, hot or not
description: GY-3501 deleted GY-3437's heat tiers: with a fixture CPU temperature of 86C and low pressure, the worker, the review and the queued trial all launch in one cycle and master status shows no hold; below 80C nothing changes. A worker launch never waits for the cycle's reviews and trials (GY-3965).

steps.name: everything launches at 86C in one cycle
